newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - DIAMONDS GLISTEN, NAMBREW DIPS.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - DIAMONDS GLISTEN, NAMBREW DIPS.

text.p: Diamond shares continued to
glisten on the Namibian Stock Exchange last week as trade in
both De Beers and Ocean Diamond Mining topped
300,000 shares.
De Beers registered volume of 157,800 shares as the counter
moved between N$166.25 and N$167.00 in total turnover of N$26.3
million.
Ocean Diamond Mining was traded every day last week as the
price climbed to N$7.60 from N$7.30 on total volume of 176,200
shares.
Elsewhere Namibia Breweries slipped to $3.05 from
N$3.28 at the start of the week on volume of 6,500 shares.
Namibian Minerals Corp , which has been untraded for
some time, slipped to N$17.50 from a previous trade at N$22.00.
Officials said total turnover on the week was 587,650 shares
worth N$40.4 million from 731,933 shares worth N$27.4 million in
the previous week.
The NSE overall index settled at 263.83 from 265.73
previously, while the NSE local index -- weighed by Naminian
Minerals and Namibia Breweries -- finished at 161.27 from 171.27
previously.
